# Payload Stack

> The agentic SaaS boilerplate for Payload CMS: Better Auth, organizations, Stripe subscriptions, a shadcn/ui dashboard and the Payload admin, wired into one Next.js app and configured from one file (src/stack.config.ts). Scaffold with `npx create-payload-stack@latest`. Open source, MIT licensed.

Every generated project ships AGENTS.md, task skills and MCP servers for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, plus `pnpm verify` to check a change. Payload Stack is a payload.solutions project, independent of and not endorsed by Payload CMS. The documentation lives on payload.solutions.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack): The SaaS boilerplate for Payload CMS.
- [Getting started](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/getting-started): From an empty directory to a signed-in dashboard.
- [CLI reference](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/cli): Every flag of create-payload-stack.
- [Agentic development](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/agents): AGENTS.md, task skills, MCP servers and one verify command for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
- [Configuration](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/configuration): Everything product-specific lives in src/stack.config.ts.
- [Authentication](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/authentication): Better Auth for the app and the Payload admin, through payload-auth.
- [Organizations](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/organizations): Better Auth organizations as Payload tenants.
- [Billing](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/billing): Stripe subscriptions with @better-auth/stripe.
- [Emails](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/emails): Transactional emails in code, or editable in the admin.
- [Legal pages and consent](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/legal): Privacy policy, terms, cookie policy and a consent banner.
- [Scheduled actions](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/scheduling): Trial reminders, dunning, sweeps and other deferred work, with a ledger.
- [Database](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/database): PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite or Vercel Postgres.
- [Media storage](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/storage): Local disk, Vercel Blob, S3, Cloudflare R2, Azure, Google Cloud Storage or Uploadthing.
- [Dashboard and UI](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/dashboard): shadcn/ui, Better Auth UI, the sidebar shell and where to put your product.
- [Observability](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/observability): Error monitoring through a provider-agnostic port.
- [Testing](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/testing): Unit, integration and end-to-end suites covering every stack.config.ts option.
- [Deployment](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/deployment): Environment variables, migrations and hosting.
- [FAQ](https://payload.solutions/docs/payload-stack/faq): Common questions about Payload Stack.

## Optional

- [When to choose Payload Stack](https://payloadstack.com/when-to-choose): When it fits, and when another starter fits better.
